ops.text: (c) HDI warrants to the Company that: (1) the Services will be performed in a professional manner and in a workmanlike manner, and for 90 days following performance of the Services the Services will conform to their documentation; (2) for 12 months following delivery, the Site, each deliverable and all software will conform to its documentation; (3) it shall perform its obligations under this Agreement in compliance with all applicable laws; and (4) the Site and any software delivered by HDI will be free of any virus or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of these warranties is repair, replacement or refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services, deliverable or software.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives only mutual authority representations, so HDI warrants nothing about the development, hosting and maintenance work itself. We added a single express warranty: professional and workmanlike Services for 90 days from performance, 12-month conformance of the Site, deliverables and software to documentation, compliance with laws and no malicious code, with repair, replacement or refund.
proposal.summary: Insert an express HDI performance warranty as Section 9(c): professional and workmanlike Services (90 days from performance), 12-month software/deliverable conformance to documentation, compliance with laws, no malicious code, remedied by repair, replacement or refund.
